videoTitle: Marketing Isn't a Department | Rory Sutherland | Re:commerce 2026
note: Rory Sutherland talks about why retention is more difficult to track compared to acquisition.
transcript: most businesses massively overrate what you might call objective measures over subjective measures. For the same reason most businesses I would argue overweight acquisition versus retention. For the simple reason that acquisition data is very quick to generate, whereas if you experiment with customer loyalty and customer attention, youre probably on to your next job before the actual figures are much. So if you think about it, why are sales people sometimes paid six figures but customer call center operatives never are? Ive argued that in a just world your very best call center people would earn a six figure salary because if youre really good, you can rescue 15 valuable customers. To justify that kind of money youd only have to save a few hundred of the best American Express car members every year. Why do they not get paid six figures up? Thats because the Salesforce can lay credit immediately and lay claim to all of the incremental revenue they bring in, whereas someone who rescues customers or creates a fantastic moment so that people become the vastly more loyal than they were before the phone call occurred, you dont have the ability to actually quantify that in the same way or at the same speed.
